correctness.rationale: For balanced a,b with M=max(a,b), position transitions are independent of arrow memory. Coupling position walks gives meeting tail <=exp(-2h/(M+1)); after meeting common departures from every vertex erase differing arrows. Uniform two-step target hitting >=m/((m+1)(M+1))=(1+o(1))/M, so union coupon bound finishes by (1+eps)2Mlog M. For lower bound initialize arrows of all M-side vertices at one opposing vertex z; before (1-eps)2Mlog M at most t/2 uniform crossings into the M side, leaving M^{eps+o(1)} untouched arrows, while stationary expected z-incoming arrows <=M/m=O(1) by part symmetry. Total variation separates. Uniform rooted-unicycle stationarity follows direct transition-column counting; no full-memory independence assumed. Finite checks are corroborative, not infinite proof.
